browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Held keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; touch buttons were pointer events on the real touch buttons; Start, language, Play again and Resume were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and canvas pixels were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: Checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page.
servedSourceCheck: The SHA-256 of the served src/games/stacksmith.js was computed in the page and matched 4a8dc2b0.

observed: A driver that reads only the status-line prompt played jobs 1 to 22 in English back to back and reached 'Nicely played! Every job is built. The harbour is proud of you!' without losing a try, swapping loads six times on the order-trap jobs. The slowest job (16, Windy Wall) took about 64 s.
Chinese job select listed all 22 job names.
Chinese: blind drops on job 3 first lost a try with '吊载不够了，再试一次', then ran out of tries with '机会用完了，塔没有立住，再试一次！'; arrow, Space and X on the loss screen changed nothing.
Chinese phone frame, 371 px wide with no horizontal overflow: touch buttons 左移 右移 放下 换载 alone selected job 1 and cleared it.
Job 21: the faint goal pictures carry readable 21t, 16t and 4t labels; the 21t label slightly overlaps the edge of the narrow weight outline but stays legible.
No console errors apart from the known synthetic-pointer capture exceptions.

limitations: Physical phones, other browsers and audio were not tested.
